title: The Inference Engineering Pareto Atlas: Which Optimizations Dominate the Cost, Quality, and Latency Frontier?
abstract: arXiv:2609.17863v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: LLM inference optimizations report speedups on different models, GPUs, prompts, and quality metrics, making them hard to compare or combine. We build a cost, quality, and latency Pareto atlas to identify the best configurations for different deployment constraints. Since exhaustive testing is impractical, we measure 54 configurations of Qwen2.5-7B-Instruct running on vLLM 0.12 across L4, A100, and H100 GPUs and use these anchors to calibrate a simulator. It reproduces measurements at anchored batch sizes, with cross campaign drift below 1.5 percent. A separate quality evaluation tests FP16, AWQ 4bit, FP8 weights, and FP8 KV cache on 200 GSM8K questions with five examples per prompt. Sparse attention is evaluated only in simulation. On the calibrated grid, 18 of 36 configurations reach the Pareto frontier. Combined methods reach it more often than individual methods, with 9 of 15 combinations versus 9 of 21 single methods. Quality testing

translated_title: 推理工程帕累托图谱：哪些优化主导成本、质量与延迟的前沿？
translated_abstract: 大语言模型（LLM）推理优化通常在不同的模型、GPU、提示词和质量指标上报告加速效果，这使得它们难以相互比较或组合使用。我们构建了一个成本、质量和延迟的帕累托图谱，以识别适用于不同部署约束的最佳配置。由于穷举测试不切实际，我们在L4、A100和H100三种GPU上测量了运行于vLLM 0.12的Qwen2.5-7B-Instruct模型的54种配置，并利用这些锚点数据校准了一个模拟器。该模拟器在锚定的批处理大小下能够复现实际测量结果，跨实验批次偏差低于1.5%。另有一项独立的质量评估在200道GSM8K数学题上测试了FP16、AWQ 4bit、FP8权重和FP8 KV缓存，每个提示词包含五个示例。稀疏注意力仅在模拟环境中评估。在校准的网格上，36种配置中有18种达到了帕累托前沿。组合方法比单一方法更常达到帕累托前沿：15种组合中有9种达标，而21种单一方法中只有9种达标。质量测试……
tldr: 该研究构建了一个成本-质量-延迟帕累托图谱，通过54种真实GPU测量配置校准模拟器，发现36种LLM推理优化配置中有18种达到帕累托前沿，且组合方法（15种中9种）比单一方法（21种中9种）更常达到前沿。
